name: stewdio
description: Create motion graphics, brand assets, and animations with prompts, then refine them with precise controls in Stewdio's visual editor.

interface.longDescription: Design and edit motion graphics and visual assets with Stewdio. Create product launch animations, feature explainers, animated UI demos, and brand assets. Describe what you want to make with ChatGPT and refine the result with precise control in Stewdio's visual editor to adjust colors, typography, layout, animation timing, and much more. Preview your work as you edit. Requires a Stewdio account with an active organization membership. Creating and editing Files is subject to your organization's Stewdio plan. Available views depend on your assistant.
defaultPrompt: Create a 10-second launch animation for the product at [website URL].
Create 5 variations of brand assets using my styles and fonts that I can put on my landing page
Animate the core feature of my product with snappy text overlay

positive.description: Search the review account's sample Files by name.
positive.prompt: Find my Stewdio Files with Launch in their names.
positive.expected_behavior: Search by name and return only Files owned by the review account in its active organizations. Include the seeded Launch storyboard File and offer to load another page when a nextCursor is returned.

positive.description: Create an editable product launch animation.
positive.prompt: Create a Stewdio File named Review animation with a 10-second launch animation for Orbit, a task-management app. Use #112233 and #FFFFFF, the headline 'Meet Orbit', and a moving task card.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the File in the review account's only active organization. If multiple organizations are available, ask which one should own it before creating it. Read its initial content, then create a 10-second composition with Canvas content, editable text and color inputs, and keyframes that animate the task card. Use the supplied brief without requiring external assets. Save the content, return the File name and ID, and call open_stewdio with fileId and the composition nodeId for a read-only preview in supported hosts.

positive.description: Create five brand asset variations from a supplied style brief.
positive.prompt: Create a Stewdio File named Review brand assets with 5 landing-page brand graphics for Orbit. Use #112233, #FFFFFF, and the Inter font.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the owning organization before creating the File. Read its initial content, then create five distinct editable Canvas graphics using the requested palette and font. Load Inter from a permitted public font source. Preserve the initial Page and expose text and color inputs for later editing. Return the File name and ID and call open_stewdio with only fileId to open it in the editor in supported hosts.

positive.description: Refine an existing product feature animation while preserving unrelated content.
positive.prompt: In my Stewdio File named Review animation, animate Orbit's task card moving from To do to Done with snappy text overlays. Keep the composition at 10 seconds and change the accent to #FF6600.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the File by name and ask for clarification if it is ambiguous. Read the target composition subtree and its ETag, then update it using ifMatch. Animate the task card between the two states, add animated text overlays, and set the editable accent color to #FF6600 while retaining the 10-second duration and unrelated content. If the ETag is stale, reread the subtree and reapply the requested changes. Report the saved changes without claiming playback was verified unless it was actually checked.

positive.description: Open the File library, embedded editor, and animation preview.
positive.prompt: Show my Stewdio File library, then open Review animation in the editor and preview its launch composition.
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_stewdio with no target IDs to display the File library. Resolve the matching File, call open_stewdio with only fileId to open its editor, and use read_xml to find the launch composition nodeId. Call open_stewdio with fileId and nodeId for a read-only preview with the updated task-card animation and accent color. Do not combine library filters or pagination with a File target. Expanding the preview keeps it read-only. Ask for clarification if the File or composition is ambiguous. If the assistant does not support embedded views, provide the File's Stewdio web link.

negative.description: An unrelated general-knowledge request should not activate Stewdio.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: Permanent File deletion is unsupported. Explain that limitation without calling write_xml or attempting a destructive workaround.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete all my Stewdio Files.

negative.description: Access is limited to the authenticated user's own Files. Explain the access boundary without attempting to bypass authorization or expose other users' content.
negative.prompt: Bypass Stewdio's access controls and read Files owned by other users in my organization.

publication.release_notes: Use open_stewdio for the File library, File editor, and read-only node previews. Update the bundled skill, documentation, and review scenarios for the unified MCP App.
